payload.title: Renderer turns bare filenames and domains into external links
payload.description:
**Problem**
Markus renders bare filenames and domain-like words as external links. Text such as `AGENTS.md`, `agent.py` or `Anth.us` in ordinary prose becomes `<a href="http://AGENTS.md">`, which points at a real outside site (.md is Moldova's country domain, .py is Paraguay's, .us is the US). Readers who click land on an unrelated third-party site, and the links look like Anthus content.

**Evidence**
Live pages built with the Papyrus/Markus renderer:
- https://chattic.us/wiki/typescript-control-plane renders `AGENTS.md` as `<a href="http://AGENTS.md">` (several times) and `VOICE.md` as `<a href="http://VOICE.md">`.
- https://chattic.us/wiki/messaging renders `Chattic.us` as `<a href="http://Chattic.us">` (and Anth.us likewise).
- https://tactus.anth.us/why-new-language/ renders `agent.py` as `<a href="http://agent.py">`.
- https://anth.us/ai-project-planning renders `project-plan.md` as `<a href="http://project-plan.md">`.
- Cause: src/markusmd/render.py:54 and :59 build `MarkdownIt("gfm-like2", {"html": ..., "linkify": True, "typographer": True})`. markdown-it-py's linkify (linkify-it) treats any `word.tld` with a real TLD as a URL. Reproduced locally: rendering "See AGENTS.md and agent.py and Anth.us" produces `<a href="http://AGENTS.md">`, `<a href="http://agent.py">` and `<a href="http://Anth.us">`.
- Papyrus delegates to Markus for this, so the fix belongs here rather than in Papyrus.

**Fix**
Restrict linkify so it only links explicit schemes: either turn linkify off and rely on explicit `<https://...>` autolinks (the GFM spec only autolinks `http(s)://` and `www.`), or enable linkify with fuzzy matching off (`md.linkify.set({"fuzzy_link": False, "fuzzy_email": False, "fuzzy_ip": False})`). Add a Gherkin scenario covering `AGENTS.md`, `agent.py`, `Chattic.us` and a real `https://example.com/x` URL, then release Markus and bump the pin in the Papyrus sites that render with it (Chattic.us-web, Tactus-web, Anth.us).

**How to verify**
Render `See AGENTS.md and agent.py, or https://example.com/x` with Markus: the output has an `<a>` only for the https URL. After the sites are rebuilt, `curl -sL https://chattic.us/wiki/typescript-control-plane | grep -c 'href="http://AGENTS.md"'` returns 0, and likewise for the other pages.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
